"anim" : "fadedrop", "dur" : 300 }, "items" : "voidanim" } } } Tatler Report: The Incredible Bordeaux 2015 Vintage Friday, June 1, 2018
After tasting about 1,300 Bordeaux 2015 in France, the JamesSuckling.com team concluded that the 2015 vintage has truly lived up to its great potential in every sense of the word. Red, white or sweet, the wines show wonderful harmony, intensity and freshness. Exciting and exquisite, the best of 2015s benefit enormously from this freshness quality, which derives from the slightly higher acidity and lower alcohol levels. Here are 10 Bordeaux wines from the 2015 vintage that have scored a perfect 100 points, and every single one of them is conclusive proof that Bordeaux is really back.
As always, we work with Asia Tatler to inform wine consumers, collectors and trade on what James is tasting, as well as our definitive selections each year. This June, Asia Tatler republished our tasting report on Bordeaux is Really Back with 2015 . For the full Tatler article in PDF, please click here . SHARE ON: Comment is required for submission!
